value.answer: Mouth spots with a low fever while hand-foot-mouth is going around is often that usually mild virus, which tends to clear in about 7 to 10 days. Fluids, rest and soft foods help. The main risk is dehydration, since a sore mouth makes kids avoid drinking.
value.triage: Call Health811 at 811 (any time) if your child won't drink, has a dry mouth, no tears, little pee, fever over 3 days, or seems very irritable or weak. Go to the ER or call 911 now for stiff neck, trouble breathing, a seizure, or if very sleepy or hard to wake.
